determinism_law: one ledger commit, ledger tree, and compiler commit produce one canonical snapshot digest
source_grouping_law: multiple source observations of one application digest are grouped before candidate evaluation
duplicate_symmetry_law: every application sharing a duplicate identifier, public key digest, or independence dimension is marked; first-writer priority is forbidden
exclusion_law: an explicit valid synthetic-test exclusion makes the entire application digest non-counting
identity_law: self-declared roots and signatures prove neither external identity nor independence
adjudication_law: counting requires admissible external adjudication under a non-empty independently governed trust-root registry
role_vector_law: each of the five roles requires one globally unique and externally verified independent application
append_law: snapshot and ledger-tree binding paths are immutable and branch ref updates are non-force fast-forwards
